text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To win the Oka Sho. Right now, that is our 
primary objective together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah! Haah!
choice_data_list: Good work today. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—doing it this way seems to suit my 
body much better...!
choice_data_list:
Alright! Let's take a 2-minute break and 
do one more set!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Kicking off the ground and 
bounding forward—like this?
choice_data_list:
I'll show you by doing it for real. Just 
watch me.
I'll show you for real, just watch, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Steadily training day after day, and then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: H-How was my time...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank... you so much—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her hard work bore fruit, and she was 
steadily moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Meanwhile, those days were nothing short 
of turbulent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Oka Sho, which tends to come down 
to explosive power, increasing her odds of 
victory requires targeted effort backed by 
the right knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I attended training sessions and 
discussion groups, continually rethinking 
the menu and running simulations. There 
were more and more days when the morning 
runs really took a toll.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, one day. The day after traveling far 
to attend a conference research 
presentation and returning late at night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading to training still running on no 
sleep, she took a nap during the break—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I jumped up and looked at the clock, only 
to find that break time was already long 
over.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry. It would have been fine to let 
you sleep, but I thought you might worry 
about it later...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like to switch to voluntary 
training today, that's completely fine by 
me.
choice_data_list:
No, sorry about that. Let's get back to 
training!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Please do not overexert 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...I thought she'd been looking pale 
lately, and it seems fatigue really has 
been catching up with her.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, having your lunch in a place like this 
today?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"This was... prepared by my Trainer. They 
said I needed a high-protein diet."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh, quite the passionate one, aren't 
they? Oh, butâthe next race is the Oka 
Sho, right? It makes sense they'd be all 
fired up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is... true.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what's the matter? Do you want to 
talk to me about it for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You're simply someone who always wants me 
to run true to myself, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Believing that is true happiness for 
Umamusume— they always, unconditionally 
put Umamusume first."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want him to shine the right 
way. Just like Ai-san, I want to gather 
the light on him—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want her to shine the right 
way. Just like Ai-san, I want to gather 
the light on her—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm the one who said I wanted to go to 
the Oka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her ability, the chances of 
winning are slim. Plus, the distance falls 
outside her comfort zone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer struggled a lot over it— but in 
the end, they respected my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And right now... because of the Oka Sho, 
I've placed such a huge burden on 
Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I just can't change it. I want 
to achieve the Triple Tiara. I simply 
cannot change that feeling—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...―― Hey, Bouquet-chan."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, wanna come check out my room?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ta-da. My spoils of war!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...! Championship sashes—! The Oka Sho, 
the Oaks, the Shuka Sho... ...The Japan 
Cup—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...It's... so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! —I want to win at everything, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because that's what makes me the happiest! 
That's why I trained, and that's why I 
challenged so many girls to race!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Winning is my ideal—which is why every day 
up until now has been for that purpose!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if your Trainer is the same 
way."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want my trainee to run in her own unique 
way.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That is his ideal. Everything up until 
now has been for that purpose."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That is her ideal. Everything up until 
now has been for that purpose."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If, in your first target race, you run in 
your own true style, and on top of that, 
you win—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was something that could prove he had 
been right all along.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was something that could prove she had 
been right all along.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It blesses all that has come before, and 
brings a tailwind for what is yet to come.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara is wonderful—yet...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
First, winning in a way that is true to 
yourself would be just as wonderful, 
wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ………… ...For me to win in my own way is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —A-Ai-san! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The one sitting right in the middle of 
your heart's scale isn't you, but your 
Trainer, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That makes it even easier to shake, and 
it's so easy to lose track of the scale 
lines—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's... so mysterious. Yet so very 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If winning in my own way can give 
strength to that person—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(A single bloom with which I affirm 
everything about him—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(A single bloom with which I affirm 
everything about her—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Could you please... let me enter the 
"Sweetpea Stakes"...!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
After you dedicated so much of your time 
and worked so hard for me, I am truly— 
truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...However—what needs to be done is 
surely waiting right there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I was amazed. To think she'd clash 
against me with such fierce momentum."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what made her come to that 
decision. Yet, her resolve seemed even 
stronger than when she dreamed of the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I wished to dedicate a brilliant, shining 
light to you, and so I set my sights on 
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"However, I felt that if I truly wish to 
make the most of these legs, our focus 
should be on the medium-distance Oaks."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it is precisely in a race 
where I can run true to myself that I have 
something I can dedicate to you—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Our first target race together. Here at 
the Oaks trial, the 1800m Sweetpea Stakes— 
this is where—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Not the light raining down upon the 
surface, but the soil that embraces the 
roots of the heart—that is what I can 
offer. I am certain of it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Touched by her gentle warmth, my heart 
nearly softened, but I hurriedly braced 
myself.
choice_data_list:
So you became certain that your dream lies 
there.

You've become certain that your dream lies 
there, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ghk, yes—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering the current situation, 
changing routes won't be an issue. In 
fact, doing so will increase our chances 
of winning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, if you are certain that 
what is most precious to her lies right 
there, then the path forward has already 
been decided.
choice_data_list:
Let's seize victory in the "Sweetpea 
Stakes".

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you so much—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I swear, I swear— I will win this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reaching out toward her dream now made 
tangible, her eyes sparkled with youthful 
brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am certain of it. The goal shifted time 
and again, —but it surely, truly wasn't a 
detour.
